description: This Java source file defines the utility class EntityFinderUtil, which provides methods and inner classes for constructing entity conditions, handling query results, and managing entity selection and pagination in the Apache OFBiz framework. It primarily facilitates dynamic query building using XML configurations and supports various output handling strategies.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods and inner classes for constructing entity conditions, handling query results, and managing entity selection and pagination within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.Condition
classes.description: Interface for defining a condition that can be created into an EntityCondition given a context, entity model, and field type reader.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.ConditionExpr
classes.description: Represents a single expression condition in XML, capable of creating an EntityCondition based on the provided XML attributes and runtime context.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.ConditionList
classes.description: Represents a list of conditions combined with a logical operator ('and'/'or'), able to produce a composite EntityCondition.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.ConditionObject
classes.description: Wraps a dynamic condition based on a field name from the context, creating an EntityCondition directly from context.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.OutputHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling the results of entity queries, either as an EntityListIterator or a list of GenericValue objects.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.LimitRange
classes.description: Handles limiting query results by start index and size, supporting both EntityListIterator and list outputs.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.LimitView
classes.description: Limits query results based on view index and size, supporting partial retrieval from an EntityListIterator or list.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.UseIterator
classes.description: Output handler that returns the EntityListIterator itself.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.GetAll
classes.description: Output handler that retrieves the complete list of results from an EntityListIterator or directly from a list.

methods.name: makeFieldMap
methods.description: Parses an XML element to create a map of FlexibleMapAccessor to values, used for setting fields in entity operations.

methods.name: expandFieldMapToContext
methods.description: Expands a field map into the context, resolving flexible expressions and expanding string placeholders.

methods.name: makeSelectFieldExpanderList
methods.description: Creates a list of FlexibleStringExpander objects from 'select-field' XML elements.

methods.name: makeFieldsToSelect
methods.description: Generates a set of field names to select based on the provided list of expanders and context.

methods.name: makeOrderByFieldList
methods.description: Creates a list of order-by fields by expanding 'order-by' expressions in the given context.
